calls.title: James X Pat: Growthbook questions
calls.summary: The meeting focused on understanding key subscriber and renewal metrics, with Patrick Condliffe estimating the subscriber base at around 1.5 million and noting a 20% churn within the first three orders. Challenges in data accessibility due to technical issues and team absences complicated discussions on renewal rates and metrics. There was significant emphasis on integrating AI into product offerings, with efforts to improve the visual editor showcased through a compelling demo from Chameleon. Patrick described a heavy initial workload but expressed optimism for more manageable hours, highlighting the need for smoother data workflows and collaboration to enhance decision-making in a fast-paced environment.
calls.keywords: subscriber count, renewal rate, lifetime value (LTV), average order value (AOV), churn rate, visual editor demo
calls.action_items:
**Patrick Condliffe**
Verify and provide accurate data on subscriber count, churn/renewal rates, average order value (AOV), and lifetime value (LTV) by Monday to support business case preparation (14:12)

**James Shannon**
Prepare a business case and demo using the subscriber, LTV, and renewal data expected from Patrick by Monday (10:04)
Present updated visual editor demo to Patrick and Jen based on recent improvements addressing previous weaknesses (14:22)
